desc.en: Actions happening right now.
desc.zh: 正在发生的动作。

rule.en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing to talk about actions happening right now.
rule.zh: 使用 am/is/are + 动词-ing 表示正在发生的动作。

questions.q: Look! The dog is ___ fast.

desc.en: Past actions ending in -ed.
desc.zh: 过去发生的规则动作 (-ed)。

rule.en: Add '-ed' to regular verbs to talk about completed past events.
rule.zh: 规则动词末尾加 '-ed' 表示过去完成的事。

questions.q: Yesterday, I ___ in the park.

title.zh: 一般过去时：不规则动词

desc.en: Common irregular past verbs (went, ate, saw).
desc.zh: 常见不规则过去式动词。

rule.en: Irregular verbs change form in the past tense (go -> went, eat -> ate, see -> saw, buy -> bought).
rule.zh: 不规则动词过去式改变形式（如 go->went, eat->ate, see->saw）。

questions.q: Yesterday, we ___ to the zoo.
He ___ an apple for breakfast this morning.
I ___ a beautiful bird in the tree yesterday.

They ___ milk before going to bed.
We ___ a great film last night.
The boy ___ his keys yesterday afternoon.

title.zh: 过去进行时：Was 与 Were

desc.en: Was and Were for actions in progress in the past.
desc.zh: 使用 Was / Were 表示过去正在进行的动作。

rule.en: Use 'was' with singular subjects (I, he, she, it) and 'were' with plural subjects (we, you, they).
rule.zh: 单数主语（I/He/She/It）用 was，复数主语（We/You/They）用 were。

questions.q: The chickens ___ running across the farmyard.
I ___ writing a letter at 8 PM yesterday.
The boys ___ playing football in the rain.
She ___ sleeping when the telephone rang.
We ___ studying together all evening.
The cat ___ chasing a mouse under the table.
They ___ waiting for the bus at 7 AM.

desc.en: Compare two people, animals, or things.
desc.zh: 比较两个人或事物。

rule.en: Add '-er' to short adjectives (taller, faster) and use 'more' before long adjectives (more beautiful).
rule.zh: 短形容词加 '-er'，多音节形容词前加 'more'。

questions.q: An elephant is ___ than a dog.
Tom is ___ than his younger brother.
A sports car is ___ than a bicycle.
This flower is ___ than that one.
My house is ___ than yours.

desc.en: Compare three or more things.
desc.zh: 三个或以上事物的最高级比较。

rule.en: Use 'the -est' for short adjectives (the tallest) and 'the most' for long adjectives (the most famous).
rule.zh: 短形容词前加 the，词尾加 -est；长形容词前加 the most。

questions.q: Jupiter is the ___ planet in our solar system.
Giraffes are the ___ land animals.
Cheetahs are the ___ animals on land.
This is the ___ story in the book.
Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
July is usually the ___ month of the year here.
She is the ___ girl in our class.

desc.en: Use me, him, her, us, and them after verbs.
desc.zh: 动词后使用 me, him, her, us, them。

rule.en: Object pronouns (me, him, her, it, us, them) receive the action of a verb.
rule.zh: 宾格代词（me, him, her, us, them）充当动词的宾语。

questions.q: Please help ___ with this heavy box.

desc.en: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs.
desc.zh: 学习 mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs。

rule.en: Possessive pronouns stand alone without a noun (This bag is mine).
rule.zh: 名词性物主代词单独使用，不带名词（如 This bag is mine）。

rule.en: Place frequency adverbs before main verbs, but after 'be' verbs.

title.en: Prepositions of Time: At, On, In

desc.en: Use at for times, on for days, in for months/years.
desc.zh: At 接时刻，On 接具体日期，In 接月份/年份。

rule.en: Use 'at' for clock times (at 8 AM), 'on' for days/dates (on Monday), and 'in' for months/years (in July).
rule.zh: 'at' 接具体点钟，'on' 接具体星期和日期，'in' 接月份、年份和季节。

questions.q: Our class starts ___ 8:00 AM.

desc.en: Many, much, some, and any.
desc.zh: Many, much, some, any 的辨析使用。

rule.en: Use 'many' with countable plural nouns and 'much' with uncountable nouns. Use 'some' in positive statements.
rule.zh: 'many' 修饰复数可数名词，'much' 修饰不可数名词，肯定句用 'some'。

questions.q: How ___ apples are on the table?

title.en: Future Tense: Will vs Going To
title.zh: 将来时：Will 与 Going to

desc.en: Express future plans and predictions.
desc.zh: 表达将来计划与预测。

rule.en: Use 'will' for spontaneous decisions/promises and 'be going to' for planned actions.
rule.zh: 'will' 用于临时决定/承诺，'be going to' 用于打算好的计划。

questions.q: Tomorrow, I ___ visit my grandparents.

title.en: Conjunctions: And, But, Or, So, Because
title.zh: 连词：And, But, Or, So, Because

desc.en: Join clauses and sentences together.
desc.zh: 连接分句与句子。

rule.en: Use 'and' for addition, 'but' for contrast, 'or' for choices, 'because' for reasons, and 'so' for results.
rule.zh: 'and' 递进，'but' 转折，'or' 选择，'because' 因果，'so' 结果。

questions.q: I like apples ___ I like bananas.

desc.en: Must for strong rules, should for advice.
desc.zh: Must 表示必须，Should 表示建议。

rule.en: Use 'must' for strong obligation/rules and 'should' for friendly advice.
rule.zh: 'must' 表示强烈的规则/义务，'should' 表示建议。

desc.en: Myself, yourself, himself, herself.
desc.zh: 学习 myself, yourself, himself, herself。

rule.en: Use reflexive pronouns when the subject and object are the same person.
rule.zh: 当主语和宾语为同一人时使用反身代词。

writing.en: If you could have any superpower for one day, what would it be and how would you use it?
writing.zh: 如果你能拥有一天的超能力，你想要什么？你会怎么使用它？

writing.en: Imagine you found a secret door in your bedroom. Where does it lead to?
writing.zh: 想象你在卧室里发现了一扇秘密门。它通向哪里？

writing.en: What is your favorite hobby? Why do you enjoy doing it in your free time?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的爱好是什么？为什么你喜欢在空闲时间做这件事？

writing.en: If you could invent a robot to help you with chores, what would it look like and what would it do?
writing.zh: 如果你能发明一个机器人帮你做家务，它长什么样，会做什么？

writing.en: Describe the perfect treehouse. What rooms and fun things would you have inside?
writing.zh: 描述一下完美的树屋。里面会有什么房间和好玩的东西？

writing.en: If you were a famous explorer, what place in the world would you want to discover?
writing.zh: 如果你是一位著名的探险家，你想去发现世界上哪个地方？

writing.en: Write a story about a pet that can talk. What do you think they would say to you?
writing.zh: 写一个关于会说话的宠物的故事。你觉得他们会对你说什么？

writing.en: Imagine you could travel to space. Which planet would you visit and what would you look for?
writing.zh: 想象你可以去太空旅行。你想去哪个星球？你想寻找什么？

writing.en: Who is your best friend? What are three fun things you like to do together?
writing.zh: 谁是你最好的朋友？你们最喜欢一起做的三件有趣的事情是什么？

writing.en: If it rained your favorite food instead of water, what would it be and how would you catch it?
writing.zh: 如果天上下的不是雨，而是你最喜欢的食物，那会是什么？你会怎么接住它？

writing.en: What would you do if you were the principal of your school for a day?
writing.zh: 如果你做了一天的校长，你会做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you found a magic pencil that makes whatever you draw become real. What is the first thing you draw?
writing.zh: 想象你找到了一支神奇的铅笔，能让你画的东西变成现实。你画的第一样东西是什么？

writing.en: If you could shrink down to the size of an ant, what adventure would you go on in your backyard?
writing.zh: 如果你能缩到蚂蚁那么小，你会在后院进行什么探险？

writing.en: Write about a time you helped someone. How did it make you feel?
writing.zh: 写一次你帮助别人的经历。这让你感觉如何？

writing.en: If animals could have jobs, what job would a dog have and why?
writing.zh: 如果动物也有工作，狗会做什么工作？为什么？

writing.en: Describe your favorite outdoor activity. Why is it fun to do outside?
writing.zh: 描述你最喜欢的户外活动。为什么在户外做这件事很有趣？

writing.en: Imagine you are stranded on a desert island. What three items would you want to have with you?
writing.zh: 想象你被困在荒岛上。你希望随身携带哪三样东西？

writing.en: If you could only eat one color of food for a week, what color would you choose and what would you eat?
writing.zh: 如果一个星期你只能吃一种颜色的食物，你会选什么颜色？你会吃什么？

writing.en: Write a story about a friendly dragon who comes to visit your town.
writing.zh: 写一个关于一条友好的龙来拜访你的小镇的故事。

writing.en: If you could breathe underwater, what kind of sea creatures would you want to play with?
writing.zh: 如果你能在水下呼吸，你想和什么样的海洋生物一起玩？

writing.en: What makes a good friend? Write about why being kind and sharing is important.
writing.zh: 什么是好朋友？写写为什么善良和分享很重要。

writing.en: Imagine you have a time machine. Would you travel to the past or the future, and why?
writing.zh: 想象你有一台时光机。你想穿越到过去还是未来，为什么？

writing.en: If you could create a new holiday, what would it celebrate and how would people celebrate it?
writing.zh: 如果你能创造一个新节日，它庆祝什么？人们会怎么庆祝它？

writing.en: Write about a time when you tried something new and difficult. Did you succeed or learn from it?
writing.zh: 写一次你尝试既新颖又困难的事情的经历。你成功了吗，或者从中学到了什么？

writing.en: If you could be any character from a book or movie, who would you be and what would you do?
writing.zh: 如果你能成为书本或电影里的任何一个角色，你想成为谁？你会做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you woke up and you were invisible. How would you spend your day?
writing.zh: 想象你醒来发现自己隐身了。你会怎么度过这一天？

writing.en: What is the best gift you have ever given someone? Why was it special?
writing.zh: 你送给别人最好的礼物是什么？为什么它很特别？

writing.en: If you could build a vehicle that travels on land, water, and air, what would it look like?
writing.zh: 如果你能制造一辆可以在陆地、水上和空中行驶的交通工具，它会是什么样子？

writing.en: Write a story about a day when all the toys in your room came alive.
writing.zh: 写一个关于你房间里所有玩具都活过来的一天的故事。

writing.en: If you could learn any language in the world instantly, which one would it be and who would you talk to?
writing.zh: 如果你能立刻学会世界上的任何一种语言，你会选哪一种？你想和谁说话？

writing.en: Imagine you found a treasure map in a bottle on the beach. Where do you think it leads?
writing.zh: 想象你在沙滩上的一个瓶子里发现了一张藏宝图。你觉得它通向哪里？

writing.en: What is your favorite season of the year? Write about the fun things you do during that time.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢一年中的哪个季节？写写在那个时候你做的有趣的事情。

writing.en: If you were a superhero, what would your name be and what costume would you wear?
writing.zh: 如果你是个超级英雄，你的名字会叫什么？你会穿什么样的服装？

writing.en: Write about a time you went on a fun trip with your family. What was the best part?
writing.zh: 写一次你和家人一起进行的有趣旅行。最棒的部分是什么？

writing.en: If you could have a wild animal as a pet, what would it be and how would you take care of it?
writing.zh: 如果你能养一只野生动物当宠物，你会养什么？你会怎么照顾它？

writing.en: Imagine you can fly like a bird. What places would you fly to and look at from above?
writing.zh: 想象你能像鸟儿一样飞翔。你会飞到哪些地方从上面俯瞰？

writing.en: What is an invention you wish existed to make your morning routine easier?
writing.zh: 你希望有什么发明能让你早上的日常生活变得更容易？

writing.en: If you had a magical garden, what kind of weird and wonderful plants would grow there?
writing.zh: 如果你有一个神奇花园，那里会生长什么奇特而美妙的植物？

writing.en: Write a story about a brave knight who has to rescue a lost kitten instead of a princess.
writing.zh: 写一个关于勇敢骑士不去救公主，而是去救一只走失的小猫的故事。

writing.en: If you could swap lives with your pet for one day, what do you think you would do?
writing.zh: 如果你能和你的宠物交换一天的生活，你觉得你会做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you found a pair of shoes that let you run super fast. Where would you run to?
writing.zh: 想象你发现了一双能让你跑得超级快的鞋。你会跑到哪里去？

writing.en: What is something you are really good at doing? How did you learn to do it so well?
writing.zh: 你非常擅长做的一件事是什么？你是怎么学得这么好的？

writing.en: If you could turn your classroom into anything for a day, what would it be? (e.g., a jungle, a spaceship)
writing.zh: 如果你能让你的教室变成任何东西一天，那会是什么？（比如：丛林、宇宙飞船）

writing.en: Write a story about an alien who comes to your school and tries to learn how to play soccer.
writing.zh: 写一个关于外星人来到你的学校，并试图学习踢足球的故事。

writing.en: If you could design your own amusement park, what would the biggest roller coaster be like?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计自己的游乐园，最大的过山车会是什么样的？

writing.en: Imagine you have a camera that takes pictures of the future. What do you see in the photos?
writing.zh: 想象你有一台能拍到未来照片的相机。你在照片里看到了什么？

writing.en: What is the most amazing dream you have ever had? Describe what happened.
writing.zh: 你做过最不可思议的梦是什么？描述一下发生了什么。

writing.en: If you could combine two animals to make a new one, what would they be and what would you call it?
writing.zh: 如果你能把两种动物结合成一种新动物，会是哪两种？你会叫它什么？

writing.en: Write about a time you solved a difficult puzzle or problem. How did you figure it out?
writing.zh: 写一次你解决一个困难的谜题或问题的经历。你是怎么想出办法的？

writing.en: If your town had a giant snowstorm and you had the day off school, what would you do in the snow?
writing.zh: 如果你的小镇下了一场大暴风雪，你放假一天，你会在雪地里做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you have a magic backpack that always has exactly what you need. What does it give you today?
writing.zh: 想象你有一个神奇的背包，里面总是有你需要的东西。今天它给了你什么？

writing.en: If you could interview a famous historical figure, who would it be and what would you ask them?
writing.zh: 如果你能采访一位著名的历史人物，你会选谁？你会问他们什么？

writing.en: Write a story about two kids who discover their treehouse can fly.
writing.zh: 写一个关于两个孩子发现他们的树屋能飞的故事。

writing.en: What is your favorite board game or video game? Why do you think it is so fun to play?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的棋盘游戏或电子游戏是什么？你为什么觉得它这么好玩？

writing.en: If you could only listen to one song for the rest of your life, what would it be and why?
writing.zh: 如果你这辈子只能听一首歌，那会是什么？为什么？

title.zh: 现在完成时：For 与 Since

desc.en: For + duration, Since + starting point.
desc.zh: For 接一段时间，Since 接时间起点。

rule.en: Use 'for' to state a length of time (for 3 years) and 'since' for a specific starting moment (since 2020).

desc.en: Had + past participle for an action before another past event.
desc.zh: Had + 过去分词表示在过去某一时间点之前已完成的动作。

rule.en: Use 'had' + past participle for an action completed before another past action.
rule.zh: 使用 'had' + 过去分词描述在另一个过去动作之前已完成的事（过去的过去）。

desc.en: Be + past participle (The book was written by...).
desc.zh: Be + 过去分词（焦点在动作承受者）。

rule.zh: 当焦点在于动作承受者时使用被动语态（be + 过去分词）。

rule.en: Use 'If + simple present, will + verb' for real future possibilities.

writing.en: How do you think artificial intelligence will change schools in the next twenty years?
writing.zh: 你认为人工智能在未来二十年里会如何改变学校？

writing.en: Write about a world where people only communicate through screens. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
writing.zh: 写一个人们只通过屏幕交流的世界。有什么优点和缺点？

writing.en: If you had a personal robot assistant, what tasks would you give it and why?
writing.zh: 如果你有一个私人机器人助手，你会让它做什么任务？为什么？

writing.en: Imagine a new form of green energy is discovered. How does it power our cities and vehicles?
writing.zh: 想象发现了一种新型绿色能源。它如何为我们的城市和车辆提供动力？

writing.en: Do you think video games can be educational? Explain your thoughts with examples.
writing.zh: 你认为电子游戏有教育意义吗？用例子解释你的想法。

writing.en: Describe a smart home of the future. What special features does it have in each room?
writing.zh: 描述一个未来的智能家居。每个房间有什么特色？

writing.en: If you could have any superpower, what would it be and how would you use it to help people?
writing.zh: 如果你可以拥有一种超能力，它会是什么？你会如何用它来帮助别人？

writing.en: If you could design a new app for smartphones, what problem would it solve?
writing.zh: 如果你能为智能手机设计一款新应用，它能解决什么问题？

writing.en: How has the internet changed the way we find information? Is it always a reliable source?
writing.zh: 互联网如何改变了我们寻找信息的方式？它总是一个可靠的来源吗？

writing.en: Why is it important to protect the environment? Share three things you can do every day to help.
writing.zh: 为什么保护环境很重要？分享三件你每天可以做的有助于环保的事情。

writing.en: Imagine you are a sea turtle swimming in the ocean. Describe the impact of plastic pollution on your life.
writing.zh: 想象你是一只在海里游泳的海龟。描述塑料污染对你生活的影响。

writing.en: What are the benefits of planting more trees in urban areas? How would it change the city environment?
writing.zh: 在城市地区种植更多树木有什么好处？它将如何改变城市环境？

writing.en: Write a persuasive paragraph encouraging your classmates to recycle and reduce waste.
writing.zh: 写一段有说服力的段落，鼓励你的同学回收利用并减少浪费。

writing.en: How does climate change affect animals living in the Arctic? What can we do to slow it down?
writing.zh: 气候变化如何影响生活在北极的动物？我们能做些什么来减缓它？

writing.en: If you were the mayor of a city, what laws would you pass to make the city more eco-friendly?
writing.zh: 如果你是一个城市的市长，你会通过什么法律让城市更加环保？

writing.en: Describe the importance of conserving water. What are some creative ways to save water at home?
writing.zh: 描述节约用水的重要性。在家里有哪些有创意的节水方法？

writing.en: Write about a time you participated in a nature cleanup or wish you had. What was the experience like?
writing.zh: 写一次你参加（或希望参加）大自然清理活动的经历。那次经历是怎样的？

writing.en: How do human activities threaten endangered species? Choose one animal to focus on.
writing.zh: 人类活动如何威胁濒危物种？选择一种动物进行重点讨论。

writing.en: What would happen if all the bees in the world disappeared? Explain the impact on our food supply.
writing.zh: 如果世界上所有的蜜蜂都消失了会发生什么？解释对我们食物供应的影响。

writing.en: Imagine you are an astronaut traveling to Mars. What are your feelings as you leave Earth, and what do you hope to discover?
writing.zh: 想象一下你是一名去火星旅行的宇航员。当你离开地球时，你有什么感觉？你希望能发现什么？

writing.en: If you could visit any planet in our solar system, which one would you choose and what would you look for?
writing.zh: 如果你能参观我们太阳系中的任何行星，你会选择哪一个？你会寻找什么？

writing.en: Write a story about finding a strange message from an alien civilization. How do you decode it?
writing.zh: 写一个关于收到来自外星文明的奇怪信息的故事。你如何解码它？

writing.en: What qualities make a good astronaut? Do you think you have what it takes for a space mission?
writing.zh: 什么品质造就了一个好的宇航员？你认为你具备执行太空任务的条件吗？

writing.en: Describe a typical day living on a space station orbiting the Earth. What are the challenges?
writing.zh: 描述在绕地球运行的空间站上生活的典型一天。有哪些挑战？

writing.en: Do you think humans should try to colonize other planets? Why or why not?
writing.zh: 你认为人类应该尝试在其他星球上殖民吗？为什么应该或为什么不应该？

writing.en: Imagine you are the first person to walk on a newly discovered moon. What are your first words?
writing.zh: 想象你是第一个踏上新发现的卫星的人。你的第一句话是什么？

writing.en: How does studying space help us understand our own planet better?
writing.zh: 研究太空如何帮助我们更好地了解我们自己的星球？

writing.en: If you could design a new spaceship, what special features would it need for deep space travel?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一艘新的宇宙飞船，进行深空旅行需要什么特殊功能？

writing.en: Write a journal entry as a space explorer who just encountered a black hole for the first time.
writing.zh: 作为一名刚刚首次遇到黑洞的太空探索者写一篇日记。

writing.en: What is your dream job for the future? Explain why you want this career and what skills you will need.
writing.zh: 你未来梦想的工作是什么？解释你为什么想要这份职业，以及你需要什么技能。

writing.en: If you could shadow a professional in your dream field for a day, who would it be and what would you ask them?
writing.zh: 如果你能跟随你梦想领域的专业人士一天，那会是谁？你会问他们什么？

writing.en: How do you plan to achieve your career goals? Describe the steps you need to take in your education.
writing.zh: 你打算如何实现你的职业目标？描述你在教育中需要采取的步骤。

writing.en: Write about a job that doesn't exist yet but might be common in 2050. What does the job involve?
writing.zh: 写一份现在还不存在，但在2050年可能很普遍的工作。这份工作包括什么？

writing.en: Why is teamwork important in almost any career? Give an example of how you work well with others.
writing.zh: 为什么团队合作在几乎所有职业中都很重要？举例说明你是如何与他人良好合作的。

writing.en: Describe a time when you failed at something but learned a valuable lesson for your future.
writing.zh: 描述一次你做某事失败但为你未来学到了宝贵教训的经历。

writing.en: What role does creativity play in a scientific or technical career? Explain your viewpoint.
writing.zh: 创造力在科学或技术职业中扮演什么角色？解释你的观点。

writing.en: If you had to choose between a highly paid job you dislike or a low-paying job you love, which would you pick and why?
writing.zh: 如果必须在你不喜欢的高薪工作和热爱但低薪的工作之间做出选择，你会选哪个？为什么？

writing.en: How can you use your future career to make a positive impact on the world?
writing.zh: 你如何利用未来的职业对世界产生积极影响？

writing.en: What skills do you think will be most important for jobs in the future? How can you learn them now?
writing.zh: 你认为哪些技能对未来的工作最重要？你现在该如何学习它们？

writing.en: If you could travel back in time to witness any historical event, which one would you choose and why?
writing.zh: 如果你能回到过去见证任何历史事件，你会选择哪一个？为什么？

writing.en: Imagine you are a sailor on Christopher Columbus's ship. Describe your feelings when you first see land.
writing.zh: 想象你是克里斯托弗·哥伦布船上的一名水手。描述你第一次看到陆地时的感受。

writing.en: Write about a historical figure who fought for civil rights. How did their actions change society?
writing.zh: 写一位为民权奋斗的历史人物。他们的行动如何改变了社会？

writing.en: If you lived during the Industrial Revolution, what would your daily life look like in a growing city?
writing.zh: 如果你生活在工业革命时期，你在不断发展的城市中的日常生活会是怎样的？

writing.en: Describe the construction of the Great Wall of China from the perspective of a worker.
writing.zh: 从一名工人的角度描述中国长城的修建过程。

writing.en: How did the invention of the printing press change the way knowledge was shared?
writing.zh: 印刷术的发明是如何改变知识传播方式的？

writing.en: Write a letter to a friend describing your experience witnessing the first airplane flight by the Wright brothers.
writing.zh: 写信给朋友，描述你见证莱特兄弟第一次飞机飞行的经历。

writing.en: Why is it important for us to study history? What lessons can we learn from past mistakes?
writing.zh: 为什么学习历史对我们很重要？我们可以从过去的错误中吸取什么教训？

writing.en: Imagine you are a reporter during the moon landing in 1969. Write the opening paragraph of your news article.
writing.zh: 想象你是1969年登月期间的一名记者。写下你新闻报道的开篇段落。

writing.en: Choose a historical mystery (like the Pyramids or Stonehenge). What is your theory on how it was built?
writing.zh: 选择一个历史谜团（如金字塔或巨石阵）。关于它是如何建造的，你的理论是什么？

writing.en: Describe a time when you faced a difficult problem. How did you use creative thinking to solve it?
writing.zh: 描述一次你面临难题的经历。你是如何用创造性思维来解决它的？

writing.en: You are lost in a dense forest with a compass, a water bottle, and a flashlight. How do you find your way out?
writing.zh: 你带着指南针、水壶和手电筒在茂密的森林中迷路了。你如何找到出路？

writing.en: Your community center needs to raise money for a new playground. Pitch a unique fundraising event.
writing.zh: 你们的社区中心需要为新操场筹集资金。提出一个独特的筹款活动。

writing.en: Imagine a bridge collapses, separating your town in half. What temporary solution can you design to keep people connected?
writing.zh: 想象一座桥塌了，把你的小镇分成了两半。你能设计什么临时解决方案让人们保持联系？

writing.en: You have been tasked with inventing a machine that cleans up ocean plastic. How does it work without harming sea life?
writing.zh: 你被派去发明一种清理海洋塑料的机器。它是如何在不伤害海洋生物的情况下工作的？

writing.en: Your school cafeteria is producing too much food waste. Propose a system to reduce and reuse the leftovers.
writing.zh: 学校食堂产生了太多的食物垃圾。提出一个减少和重新利用剩菜的系统。

writing.en: If you were locked in a museum overnight, how would you keep yourself safe and entertained using the exhibits?
writing.zh: 如果你被整夜锁在博物馆里，你将如何利用展品来保证自己的安全并自娱自乐？

writing.en: Design a new sport that combines elements of soccer and swimming. What are the rules?
writing.zh: 设计一项结合足球和游泳元素的新运动。规则是什么？

writing.en: A spaceship has crash-landed in your backyard. How do you communicate with the aliens who only speak in colors?
writing.zh: 一艘宇宙飞船在你的后院坠毁。你如何与只会用颜色交流的外星人沟通？

writing.en: You need to teach a complex math concept to a group of first graders. Describe a fun game you would use to explain it.
writing.zh: 你需要给一群一年级学生教一个复杂的数学概念。描述一个你会用来解释这个概念的有趣游戏。
